title: File:Flocculation of Microplastics with Fenugreek Polymer.jpg
desc: This image shows the process of flocculating water that has been confirmed to be polluted by microplastics. Fenugreek polymer has been added for the flocculation process in order to adsorb the microplastics for removal from the water.
